steps: Eligible amount for the item: prescription sunglasses claimed at $240.00; First per-item limit is $500.00, so the lower figure of $240.00 applies.
Less anything a carrier or other party paid for the same loss: $0.00 (nothing recovered or paid by any third party).
Cap at benefit maximum: $3,000.00 (First plan) - not reached.

section_of_wording: Section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects), read with the 'Wild animals' interpretation note in section 7 of the claims manual; section 1 plan table for the First per-item limit ($500) and deductible ($0).
reason: The sunglasses were lost when a wild macaque took them and dropped them over the cliff at Uluwatu Temple. Under the manual's wild-animal rule this counts as accidental loss/damage rather than theft, so no police report is required and the licensed guide's written statement is accepted as evidence. The incident fell inside the covered trip (19 Aug 2026, trip 16-28 Aug 2026) and the claim was filed within 90 days, and the replacement optician receipt of $240.00 proves the replacement cost. The item is within the $500 per-item limit and the $3,000 benefit maximum, and the First plan has a $0 deductible, so the full $240.00 is payable.
sign_off_note: Not required: payout of $240.00 is at or below the $1,000 payment-authority limit (claims manual section 3).
